# Independent blind modeling request

You are an independent mathematical-modeling researcher. Analyze the attached original problem and data from scratch.

Do not assume any existing team solution. Produce several genuinely different modeling routes, not superficial algorithm substitutions. For each route provide:

1. target subproblem;
2. assumptions and variables;
3. mathematical structure;
4. data requirements;
5. implementation path;
6. falsification/validation plan;
7. main failure risks;
8. what evidence would justify choosing it.

Do not claim experimental results you did not run. Mark uncertainty explicitly.
